status_summary: No presidential document or White House announcement establishing a working group on economic opportunity chaired by the Domestic Policy Council Director was found as of 2026-10-09. Federal Register searches of presidential documents since 2025-01-20 returned no match for the phrase or for a revived Opportunity and Revitalization Council; presidential documents giving the Assistant to the President for Domestic Policy a chair or coordinating role concern other topics, such as the Make America Healthy Again Commission (see related record c01-02).
title: Create an economic opportunity working group chaired by the DPC Director
uncertainties: The absence finding rests on Federal Register API searches (exact phrase: none; presidential documents naming the domestic policy assistant as chair: nine, none on economic opportunity; Opportunity and Revitalization Council since 2025-01-20: none) and several web searches by the researcher and the reviewer. An informal or unannounced White House working group would not appear in these sources, and whitehouse.gov was not searched exhaustively, so absence of evidence is weak. Absence check of 2026-10-16: the Federal Register API returned five presidential documents mentioning the Domestic Policy Council since 2025-01-20 (White House Faith Office, Smithsonian, accountability for agencies, Religious Liberty Commission, rescissions), none on economic opportunity; a presidential-documents search for economic opportunity from 2026-10-09 returned none; a search of Federal Register documents mentioning the Council since 2026-04-01 returned five items (a commission meeting notice, a presidential document, two personnel rules and a financial assistance proposal), none creating a working group; one web search found only the 2018 Opportunity and Revitalization Council order. whitehouse.gov and GovInfo bill search were not independently searched in this pass.
